description: Harmonized annual income value. Stage 01 applies the annual income-scale divisor and, when a member field is configured, divides household income by the member count. Exact annual rules are recorded in pnad_annual_metadata.csv.
source: Stage 02 annual trusted PNAD Parquet files; values retained unchanged after Stage 02 row selection
calculation: income_raw / income_scale_divisor; additionally / member_count when stage01_divides_by_members is true
